title: Digital TEI-XML edition of Camillo Porzio's "La congiura de' Baroni del Regno di Napoli contra re Ferdinando primo"
notes: A Zenodo-published TEI-XML dataset of the critical digital edition of Porzio's La congiura de' Baroni (first published Naples 1565), encoded and curated by Cristiano Amendola; matches the RQ origin (single text). DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18047915 verified live; license CC BY 4.0. RQ holds the TEI-derived text (~49k words). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Cristiano Amendola (KU Leuven), within PRIN 2022 "HISTORIALE MARE" (PI Fulvio Delle Donne, Università di Napoli Federico II)
license_note: No reuse licence established from the available publisher-source evidence.
